reviewer: publication-auditor (FIG-01..19 independent re-review against patched text P-01..P-07; FIG-20..57 scenario-map semantic review against RC485)

FIG-20.issue: Legend does not match map glyphs: the light-grey 'hazard area' fill used for the four Unstable Ground zones (FIG-29) and the light diagonal 'Deep Shadow' hatch used for the Under Passage (FIG-37) have no swatch or label in the key; the only grey swatch is 'Impassable or Blocking, decided per piece'.

FIG-23.issue: Bandit Reinforcement arrows (R3) are drawn at 10" along each edge, but the source places arrivals at the MIDPOINT of the edge closest to the Toll Captain. The drawn entry points are therefore wrong on all four edges (midpoint = 18").

FIG-25.issue: Unlogged source conflict drawn as settled: Group 3 is to be placed 'at the perimeter of the Bandit Camp, 6" from its centre', but the Camp is only about 4"x4" so its perimeter lies about 2" (max 2.8") from the centre, not 6". The map silently follows the '6" from centre' clause with a solid marker and a 6" ring, putting the Group 4" outside the Camp edge.

FIG-29.issue: The four 3"x3" Unstable Ground zones (the scenario's key terrain) are unreadable: they use an unlisted light-grey fill, three are partly covered by the 'G4 R2', 'G2·R' and 'Ruin 4"x4"' label halos so they read as L-shapes, and only one is labelled ('Unstable 3"x3"'). The 'min 6"' ruler runs between zones that cannot be identified.

FIG-37.issue: Required terrain missing: the Under Passage must be 'walled on both sides by Blocking Terrain', but the map draws only a dashed shaded polygon; no walls are shown. The shading ('Deep Shadow' hatch) is not in the key and not labelled, so the reader cannot tell what the passage fill means.

FIG-40.issue: Group 2 constraint not met by the drawn arrangement: the source places Group 2 'inside a ruined building adjacent to the Laboratory', but G2 sits in building bd2, about 3" from the Laboratory footprint (adjacent = 1" or less per 2.1).

open_majors.issue: Legend does not match map glyphs: the light-grey 'hazard area' fill used for the four Unstable Ground zones (FIG-29) and the light diagonal 'Deep Shadow' hatch used for the Under Passage (FIG-37) have no swatch or label in the key; the only grey swatch is 'Impassable or Blocking, decided per piece'.

open_minors: Key only says 'Grey dashed = one legal arrangement'. It does not say that a SOLID marker/zone drawn with a distance symbol (e.g. 'within 3"', 'at least 8"', corner zone chosen by the Roll-off winner) is one position meeting the printed constraint, not a fixed position. Solid CONSTRAINED and MANDATORY_POSITION elements look identical.

Letters A/B beside exit arrows (FIG-29) and Party A/B zone letters are not explained; in scenarios with role assignment (FIG-32, 37, 38, 44, 50, 52, 54, 55) Party A/B are scenario roles assigned by die roll and are not tied to the drawn zone.

Label 'Tarantula·R' sits on top of the Tree piece (tr1) and hides its Cover pattern; the 'Ravine 6-8"' label is crossed by the Tarantula leader line.

open_minors: Mother Tree (3-4" Blocking, MANDATORY centre) is unlabelled, and the 'Totem' label overlaps its dark disk; the three-chest rotation (evenly spaced, rotation open) is drawn solid.
Dense cluster at the Dome: 'Lens', 'min 10"', 'Dome 6"x6"', 'Sentinel·A', '2"' labels crowd the dome edge and hazard markers; readable but at the limit at 9 pt.
Group 2 arrival arrows (R3) are drawn solid at a fixed 8" along both long edges; the source gives only 'a random edge that is neither party's deployment edge' (no point on the edge).
'Gateway 4-6"' label sits below the Courtyard border away from the gate on the east edge and 'G1·R' is placed 4" from the colonnade it is meant to be 'amongst'.

open_majors.issue: The four 3"x3" Unstable Ground zones (the scenario's key terrain) are unreadable: they use an unlisted light-grey fill, three are partly covered by the 'G4 R2', 'G2·R' and 'Ruin 4"x4"' label halos so they read as L-shapes, and only one is labelled ('Unstable 3"x3"'). The 'min 6"' ruler runs between zones that cannot be identified.

open_minors: Hall orientation (8"x4", long axis E-W) and the chamber layout around it are not fixed by the source but the Hall is drawn solid.
Zones are lettered A/B, but in this scenario Party A (Sealers) and Party B (Openers) are assigned by die roll and need not match the drawn zones; the Door label is also crowded by the G3·A marker.
The Cave wall (cw1) is almost completely hidden under the 'Fungi' and 'Cave wall' label halos; the 'Cave wall' label points at nothing visible.
Chasm (8" wide, MANDATORY) is drawn with the Impassable hatch although the source defines it through Chasm Fall/Jump, not as Impassable Terrain.

Ledger ambiguity 'start edge' is genuine but low-impact: step 11's first clause (winner chooses the edge) arguably supplies the chooser even though the 'other party takes the opposite edge' clause is displaced by the scenario. Map is symmetric so the drawn top edge is harmless.
Low defensive walls are drawn with the Impassable pattern; the source gives a terrain type only for the Guard Towers and Tent. The 'Low wall' label sits far above its wall.

open_minors: 'The central cavern and tunnels are in Deep Darkness' is not indicated on the map; 'Caller·A' label overlaps a Stalagmite piece.
The c1-c2 and G1-c2 'min 6"' rulers are nearly collinear and read as one long line through the G1 marker; number of Random Monster Groups (10.6.4, variable) is not stated though two are drawn.

open_majors.issue: Group 2 constraint not met by the drawn arrangement: the source places Group 2 'inside a ruined building adjacent to the Laboratory', but G2 sits in building bd2, about 3" from the Laboratory footprint (adjacent = 1" or less per 2.1).

open_minors: 'Frozen Debris' is Cover Terrain tagged Difficult Terrain but is drawn as Cover only.
'Grand Hall' label sits over the Cracked ice patch (ic1) and hides most of it.
Workbenches are drawn with the Impassable pattern although the source gives them no terrain type.

The Ice Throne the Magistrate begins on is not drawn or labelled; the Ice Mephit (Sz S) uses the generic M glyph; G1 is shown in open ground not in an 'outer corridor' (corridors outer to the chambers are not drawn). Zones A/B vs Shard Seekers/Bounty Hunters not tied (see FIG-20).
Oasis cluster is cramped: 'Oasis 8"x8"', 'Wellspring', 'Chieftain·A', 'G1·A' labels hide the Oasis top/right outline.

The three Elemental Locus pillars (Impassable Terrain, 4-6" from the Altar) are drawn as objective diamonds; the Impassable nature is lost. Zone depth 6" is the step 11 default but is drawn like a printed value.
Deep Sand is drawn with the Difficult Terrain pattern and Fallen Pillar with Impassable; the source gives neither a terrain type.
Colossus is drawn as a solid 7"x7" Blocking square; the source gives only 'large central terrain feature' (no size), so the size should look illustrative.
Glyphic Stones (Impassable Terrain) are drawn as objective diamonds; the central Dais is drawn solid 5"x5" although no size is given.

Group 2 'patrolling murky water' is drawn in an outer Shallow patch; the only rule-defined Murky Water is 'within the Sunken Barrow mound' (14258), so the placement may be illegal. Possible unlogged ambiguity. Sanctum outline is partly hidden by the Shallow/Reliquary/Sanctum labels.
Reed screens are drawn with the Difficult pattern; the source gives no terrain type.

Thorny Vines are Cover, Difficult, Dangerous and Natural but the Grove is drawn as Cover only; Corrupted Muck is drawn Difficult without source support; 'Thornlings·A' label overlaps the Mangroves piece.
